title: SMAP 土壤水分衛星
summary: 用合成校準線反演體積含水量，量化亮溫誤差與不適用地表的影響。
summaryEn: Invert a synthetic calibration line for volumetric moisture and quantify brightness-temperature error and invalid surfaces.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. New θ=0.20 m³/m³; ±2 K corresponds to ±0.02 m³/m³.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
steps.checkEn: Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學局部線性模型 Tb=a−bθ；θ=(a−Tb)/b。植被、粗糙度與地表溫度未建模時不可外推。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching local linear model Tb=a−bθ gives θ=(a−Tb)/b; do not extrapolate when vegetation, roughness or surface temperature are unmodelled.

steps.title: 亮溫與含水量 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Brightness and moisture · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「亮溫與含水量」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Brightness and moisture and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
Tb 改變可能源於土壤溫度、植被或含水量；只用一個頻道不能唯一分辨。
對照「亮溫與含水量」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只在校準適用域且地表條件相符時接受；超域不裁切成邊界值而應加旗標。
本階段必須重驗：觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
steps.instructionEn:
Tb change may arise from soil temperature, vegetation or moisture; one channel alone does not uniquely separate them.
Against the nominal Brightness and moisture result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Accept only within calibration validity and matched surface conditions; flag out-of-range results rather than clipping them silently.
Reverify this criterion: Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。Tb 改變可能源於土壤溫度、植被或含水量；只用一個頻道不能唯一分辨。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Tb change may arise from soil temperature, vegetation or moisture; one channel alone does not uniquely separate them.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
steps.checkEn: Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.

steps.title: 亮溫與含水量 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Brightness and moisture · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「亮溫與含水量」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Brightness and moisture and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付校準範圍、誤差傳播及超域遮罩，不宣稱格點即獨立觀測。
在交接件中加入「亮溫與含水量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用合成校準線反演體積含水量，量化亮溫誤差與不適用地表的影響。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver calibration domain, propagated error and out-of-range mask without treating each grid cell as independent evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Brightness and moisture: Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Invert a synthetic calibration line for volumetric moisture and quantify brightness-temperature error and invalid surfaces. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 觀測與估計變數分開，θ 標體積比。
steps.checkEn: Observation and estimate remain separate; θ is a volume fraction.
